notes: MOTHER CORRECTION (research 2026-07-04, resolving Martha Taber Hedger's parent-too-young flag): this Mary Ann Cheesman -- b. 16 Sep 1746, d. c.1840s Ohio -- is independently documented on WikiTree (Cheseman-5, as 'Mary Ann (Cheseman) Jackson'), with an exact date match, as the daughter of Peter Cheesman and his SECOND wife, Ann Hanna (Ellis) Cheesman (b. 16 Apr 1710 England, d. 1759 Gloucester NJ; Ellis-4456 cross-lists Mary Ann as her daughter), NOT of Martha Taber Hedger. Peter's 1786 will (per the Albert Stirling Adams 'Cheesman Family' manuscript) bequeaths Mary Ann ('Mary Ann(4) Jackson') 5 shillings, noting she had 'already' received 400 acres -- consistent with her being an adult, previously-provided-for daughter well before Martha's presumed late-life marriage to Peter. Machine-owned parents array left unedited per repo convention; see docs/research/ancestors/gen09-martha-taber-hedger-eliza-bolton-taber.md and I182195863485.json (Peter Cheesman) manual.notes for full sourcing.
